headline: Brief v2.0.7-beta — 150-Frame Live Vision, PC-Style Proportional Cursor, Zero Self-Stop & Auto-Updater
bullets: Zero Self-Stop + PC-Style Proportional Cursor: Moved Stop out of top-right app search bars with gesture pass-through; proportional Phone -> Tablet -> PC cursor with curved glide, custom speed, target check reticle & click bounce.

150-Frame Live Vision & Smarter Multi-Step AI: Samples up to 150 frames for UI stability, attaches calibrated 0..1000 HD vision + 150 UI nodes on every step, auto-submits searches, and completes full multi-step goals.
Live Remote News & Auto-Updater: Automatic update detection & in-place APK upgrade for Samsung, Honor & all Android phones/tablets plus Windows & Linux.
